name: galaxy-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your Galaxy server: histories, datasets, tools and workflows.
long_description: Gives Claude Desktop access to a Galaxy server through the galaxy-mcp server. Claude can list and create histories, upload and inspect datasets, search and run Galaxy tools, import and invoke workflows (including IWC workflows), and check job status. You need an account on a Galaxy server (for example usegalaxy.org, usegalaxy.eu or usegalaxy.org.au) and an API key from User > Preferences > Manage API Key.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Show the Galaxy user the server is connected as

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file to a history

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run a Galaxy tool with given inputs

tools.name: invoke_workflow
tools.description: Run a workflow on a history

galaxy_url.title: Galaxy URL
galaxy_url.description: Base URL of your Galaxy server, e.g. https://usegalaxy.org

galaxy_api_key.title: Galaxy API key
galaxy_api_key.description: From the Galaxy web UI: User > Preferences > Manage API Key
